title: "unsat, therefore safe" over contradictory premises
violates: Non-vacuity: the premises can hold together, so that an unsat says something about the property.
because: Contradictory premises make every violation query unsat, whatever the property says. Here a transfer must be positive and at most a limit that the configuration sets to zero.
class: a proof over premises that cannot hold together

cured_by.text: Ask the premise query beside every unsat, and fix the configuration that empties the premises.

also.caption: The violation query on the same premises is unsat, which on its own reads as a pass.
So is the violation query of an absurd property, which no pass should ever cover.
